C16.ig:
«قبل أن تنام» 🤍
Before you go to sleep: 4 Sunnahs of the Prophet ﷺ.

أربع سنن نبوية تختم بها يومك، ولا تأخذ إلا دقائق.
Four Sunnahs to end your day with. They only take a few minutes.

احفظها لتقرأها الليلة، وأرسلها لمن تحب 🤍
Save it for tonight, and send it to someone you love.
Follow @taqwalantern for daily reminders.

1. Sahih al-Bukhari 6324 (Hudhayfah, رضي الله عنه) · 2. Sahih al-Bukhari 6319, 5017 (‘A’ishah, رضي الله عنها) · 3. Sahih al-Bukhari 5361 · Sahih Muslim 2727 (‘Ali, رضي الله عنه) · 4. Jami‘ at-Tirmidhi 3398, graded sahih (Darussalam) · Sunan Abi Dawud 5045. Hadith English: Sunnah.com (1), HadeethEnc.com (2–4).

#أذكار_النوم #السنة_النبوية #أذكار #sunnah #dhikr
C16.fc:
أيّها تقولها كل ليلة؟ 👇
Which one do you say every night? 👇
alt: Cover: a golden lantern under an arch on a dark blue background. Before you go to sleep: 4 Sunnahs of the Prophet, peace be upon him. Swipe.
1 of 4, as you lie down: With Your name, O Allah, I die and I live. Sahih al-Bukhari 6324, in Arabic with English.
2 of 4, al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and an-Nas: whenever the Prophet went to his bed, he would blow into his hands, recite the Mu'awwidhat, and pass his hands over his body. Sahih al-Bukhari 6319 and 5017.
3 of 4, better than a servant: when you go to bed, say Subhan Allah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times and Allahu Akbar 34 times. Sahih al-Bukhari 5361 and Sahih Muslim 2727.
4 of 4, hand under your head: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You gather or resurrect Your servants. Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3398 and Sunan Abi Dawud 5045.
Save it for tonight, and send it to someone you love. Keep us in your du'a. Follow @taqwalantern for daily reminders.
C16.sound: Reel 19 "I Am Near" (night) · backup Reel 17 "Never Lose Hope"

C17.ig:
«في خطبة الجمعة» 🤍
At the Friday khutbah: even this one word.

الخطبة جزءٌ من الجمعة، فأقبِل عليها بقلبك.
The khutbah is part of Jumu'ah. Give it your full attention.

احفظها لكل جمعة، وأرسلها لمن تصلي معه الجمعة 🤍
Save it for every Friday, and send it to someone you pray Jumu'ah with.
Follow @taqwalantern for daily reminders.

Sahih Muslim 851 · Sahih al-Bukhari 934 (Abu Hurayrah, رضي الله عنه). Hadith English: HadeethEnc.com.

#الجمعة #يوم_الجمعة #السنة_النبوية #jumuah #hadith
C17.fc:
هل تذهب مبكرًا إلى الجمعة؟ 👇
Do you go early to Jumu'ah? 👇
alt: Cover: a golden lantern under an arch on a dark blue background. At the Friday khutbah: even this one word. An authentic hadith, Bukhari and Muslim. Swipe.

A teaching of the Prophet, peace be upon him: If you say to your companion 'listen' on Friday while the Imam is delivering the sermon, you have thus engaged in idle talk. Sahih Muslim 851 and Sahih al-Bukhari 934, in Arabic with English.
Save it for every Friday, and send it to someone you pray Jumu'ah with. Keep us in your du'a. Follow @taqwalantern for daily reminders.
C17.sound: Reel 09 "The Best Day" · backup Reel 21 "Within Your Capacity"

C18.ig:
«إذا نزل المطر» 🤍
When it starts to rain: 3 du'as from the Sunnah.

المطر رحمة من الله، فلا تتركه يمرّ دون ذكر.
Rain is a mercy from Allah. Don't let it pass without remembering Him.

احفظها للمطر القادم، وأرسلها لمن عندهم مطر الآن 🤍
Save it for the next rain, and send it to someone where it's raining now.
Follow @taqwalantern for daily reminders.

1. Sunan an-Nasa'i 1523, graded sahih (al-Albani; Darussalam), with a shorter wording in Sahih al-Bukhari 1032 (‘A’ishah, رضي الله عنها) · 2. Sahih al-Bukhari 846 · Sahih Muslim 71 (Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani, رضي الله عنه) · 3. Sahih al-Bukhari 1014 · Sahih Muslim 897 (Anas, رضي الله عنه), excerpt. Hadith English: Sunnah.com (1–2), HadeethEnc.com (3).

#المطر #دعاء #السنة_النبوية #dua #sunnah
C18.fc:
هل تمطر عندكم الآن؟ اكتب مدينتك 👇
Is it raining where you are? Tell us your city 👇
alt: Cover: a golden lantern under an arch on a dark blue background. When it starts to rain: 3 from the Sunnah. Swipe.
1 of 3, when you see rain: O Allah, make it beneficial rain. Sunan an-Nasa'i 1523 and Sahih al-Bukhari 1032, in Arabic with English.

2 of 3, after the rain, a short phrase in Arabic. Allah said, in a hadith qudsi: whoever said that the rain was due to the Blessings and the Mercy of Allah had belief in Me. Sahih al-Bukhari 846 and Sahih Muslim 71.
3 of 3, when the rain is too much: O Allah, around us and not upon us. Sahih al-Bukhari 1014 and Sahih Muslim 897.
Save it for the next rain, and send it to someone where it's raining now. Keep us in your du'a. Follow @taqwalantern for daily reminders.
C18.sound: Reel 01 "Patience and Prayer" (soft rain) · backup Reel 03 "With Hardship Comes Ease"

C19.ig:
«تعرف أحدًا تزوّج حديثًا؟» 🤍
Know someone who just got married? Send them this du'a.

أجمل تهنئة للعروسين: دعاءٌ من السنة.
The best congratulations for a new couple: a du'a from the Sunnah.

أرسلها لمن تزوّج حديثًا، واحفظها للعرس القادم 🤍
Send it to someone who just got married, and save it for the next wedding.
Follow @taqwalantern for daily reminders.

Sunan Abi Dawud 2130, graded sahih (al-Albani) · Jami‘ at-Tirmidhi 1091, graded sahih (Darussalam) (Abu Hurayrah, رضي الله عنه). Hadith English: Sunnah.com.

#الزواج #دعاء #السنة_النبوية #nikah #dua
C19.fc:
اكتب دعاءً للعروسين 👇
Write a du'a for the newlyweds 👇
alt: Cover: a golden lantern under an arch on a dark blue background. Know someone who just got married? Send them this du'a. Swipe.

What the Prophet, peace be upon him, said to the newlywed: May Allah bless you and send blessings upon you, and bring goodness between you. Sunan Abi Dawud 2130 and Jami' at-Tirmidhi 1091, in Arabic with English.
Send it to someone who just got married, and save it for the next wedding. Keep us in your du'a. Follow @taqwalantern for daily reminders.
